no_success_criterion_by_design.statement: EXP-YIELD-003 has NO success criterion and NO falsification criterion. The mean, sd and SEM of z_sem are observations feeding nothing, and NO OUTCOME OF IT FALSIFIES ANYTHING.
no_success_criterion_by_design.why_that_is_correct: The statistic under replication fires nothing and never did. Inventing a criterion here would manufacture a test the question does not support.

how_RT21_1_is_avoided.the_failure_being_avoided: The EXP-YIELD-002 C-20 clause made a FALSE power sentence mandatory on every downstream record, and it was carried verbatim into two immutable artifacts after three pre-execution reviews called it correct.
how_RT21_1_is_avoided.what_this_contract_does: It does not reproduce or paraphrase the sentence, and it CREATES NO MANDATORY-SENTENCE CLAUSE OF ITS OWN - arguing that the C-20 mechanism was itself the propagation channel. PRED-ID is extended to bind power, sensitivity, count and magnitude statements; the contract states it has NO POWER AT ALL, having no criterion; and every self-referential number is marked HAND-DERIVED AND NOT MACHINE-VERIFIED at the point of use and routed to the reviewer.
how_RT21_1_is_avoided.assessment: This is the right structural response. The cardinality-not-identity failure has recurred three times in this lineage; removing the propagation mechanism is a stronger fix than correcting the sentence.
